name: Whitechain

key_findings: Lowest TradFi score on the board and first Speculative tier -- 39 points below the binding Regulatory Clarity cap (65), the widest raw-to-cap gap recorded on either axis.
First single-validator chain scored under either framework -- a go-ethereum fork running Clique Proof-of-Authority with one authorized signer operated by WhiteBIT.
On-Chain Health (10) is the lowest on the board -- official explorer reports 0.00 current TPS, no coverage on any major analytics platform.
Established AI Principle 17 -- tier reads from the published rounded score, not the raw. Raw 39.64 rounds to 40 and takes Prototype Only rather than Not Viable.
The Deterministic Finality FAIL cap is entirely decorative here -- raw sits 14 points below it, so the category layer alone produced the result.
State & API Quality (30) -- one official RPC endpoint, no subgraphs, no coverage on any major indexer.

watch_items: Circulating supply is reported inconsistently across sources (118.1M to 213.4M, a 1.8x spread) -- a transparency issue worth re-checking at next assessment.
Second-widest negative divergence on the board behind MON.
